# Semlink 2.4.3

Hotfix for a 2.4.2 regression, no other changes.

## 🏠 Home screen input card position

- On a fresh app start the input card sank to the bottom of the home screen instead of sitting mid-page inside the welcome grid (right below the greeting, as tuned in 2.4.x)
- Cause: the home render runs before the input card element is constructed, so the placement pass skipped it and nothing re-ran afterwards; a final layout sync now executes at the end of view construction

**Download**: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are attached to this release. Updating from inside Obsidian picks up all three automatically.
